scenes.text: When suddenly, your phone goes off.
Sirens everywhere. The nearest shelter is miles away. You won't make it.
So you grab a shovel and start digging.
Deep. Because dirt is one of the best shields against fallout.
You line it with concrete, so it can't cave in.
Add a roof, and pile the dirt back on top.
Then a heavy hatch you can seal from the inside.
But you need air. So you run a vent up, with a filter to stop the dust.
Canned food. Enough for two weeks.
A bed, because you could be down here a while.
And a hand crank radio, so you know when it's safe to come out.
You're in. Hatch sealed. Just in time.
But it's not finished. What do we add next? Top comment gets built in part two.
